name: Omabump
author: vladkarok
description: Agent desktop apps and CLIs at the version the vendor shipped, ahead of the Omarchy repo.

barWidget.description: Shows when a vendor has released a newer version of an installed agent desktop app or CLI, and updates it in a terminal through Omarchy's recipe, the vendor's Arch package or mise when you press Update.

schema.label: Notify on new versions
schema.description: Send a desktop notification when a vendor publishes a version newer than the installed one.

schema.label: Show mise tools
schema.description: List the agent CLIs mise has installed (Claude Code, Codex CLI, OpenCode...) after the desktop apps.

schema.label: Hide icon until an update
schema.description: Show the bar icon only when an installable update exists. IPC open and toggle still open the panel.
